notes: Bucharest blue street plate with green border and arched 'SECTOR 5' cap, on a pole; t-comma-below (ț, U+021B) in both Piața and Națiunile. A scratch runs across the plate near 'Unite'. Distractors: rusty blank sign below, 'SARTO' billboard ('Nu renunța la bere, fă-ți costumul pe comandă.', small) in the background. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Husky

notes: White plate with blue caps over a carved wooden doorway (funeral home); a generic service description rather than a brand name, so the query relies on the category. A cracked wire runs across the plate. Distractors: partial blue plate 'PI...' at the right edge and a round sign 'AT... / G...' cut off by the frame.
